title: The Amber Spyglass
author: Philip Pullman
summary: The final book of His Dark Materials sends Lyra and Will through the land of the dead and into a war between heaven and earth. Armies, angels and very strange beings take sides.
readIf: you want a daring conclusion that tackles big questions about faith, growing up and sacrifice.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier two books, or dislike stories that challenge organised religion.

pairings.reason: Another portal fantasy that gets darker and more adult, and asks what magic costs.
A calmer, more compact fantasy that grapples with the same idea of balance and death.
Another children's fantasy that grows into a much deeper meditation on imagination and loss.
